ClairText_GiveDragonbreathDragonDen:
CLAIR: I'm sorry
about this.

Here, take this as
my apology.
ClairText_DescribeDragonbreathDragonDen:
That contains
DRAGONBREATH.

No, it doesn't
have anything to do with my breath.

If you don't want
it, you don't have to take it.
ClairText_NoRoom:
Oh? You don't have
any room for this.

I'm going back to
the GYM, so make

room, then come
see me there.
ClairText_WhatsTheMatterDragonDen:
CLAIR: What's the
matter? Aren't you

going on to the
#MON LEAGUE?

Do you know how to
get there?

From here, go to
NEW BARK TOWN.

Then SURF east to
#MON LEAGUE.

The route there is
very tough.

Don't you dare
lose at the #- MON LEAGUE!

If you do, I'll
feel even worse

about having lost
to you!

Give it everything
you've got.
DragonShrineSignpostText:
DRAGON SHRINE

A shrine honoring
the dragon #MON

said to have lived
in DRAGON'S DEN.
RivalText_Training1:
…
What? {PLAYER}?

…No, I won't
battle you now…

My #MON aren't
ready to beat you.

I can't push them
too hard now.

I have to be dis-
ciplined to become

the greatest #-
MON trainer…
RivalText_Training2:
…

Whew…

Learn to stay out
of my way…
CooltrainermDarinSeenText:
You! How dare you
enter uninvited!
CooltrainermDarinAfterBattleText:
The SHRINE ahead
is home to the

MASTER of our
dragon-user clan.

You're not allowed
to just go in!
CooltrainerfCaraAfterBattleText:

get permission

from our MASTER to
use dragons.

When I do, I'm
going to become an

admirable dragon
trainer and gain

our MASTER's
approval.

don't know.

to battle LANCE.

MASTER will be
